end.summary:
- Practised identifying standing, sleeping, and slanting straight lines.
- Identified standing lines in stumps and a flagpole.
- Identified sleeping lines in a goalpost crossbar and table edge.
- Identified slanting lines and distinguished straight lines from curved lines.
- Clarified that a slanting line can be straight when it has no bend; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping, and slanting lines using familiar objects. They used the direction of a line and whether it bends; their mix-up about a slanting line being straight was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to find and name one example of each line type, including a slanting line with no bend.
